resources.string: Server response code: %1$d. An unconfirmed result is not treated as success.
The original connection is not ready. Reconnect, then check again. No message was resent.
Message history could not be read. Delivery remains unconfirmed; no message was resent.
Reading the original history requires authentication or permission. Delivery remains unconfirmed.
The saved ID was not found in this bot\'s current history store. Delivery remains unknown.
No saved session ID is available for this send. Its result cannot be checked automatically.
The exact request was not found in the available history page. Delivery remains unconfirmed.
The request is present, but a final reply has not been confirmed. No message was resent.
A confirmed reply was restored to its original conversation. Other unconfirmed sends remain unchanged.
There are no saved unconfirmed sends to check.
The connection changed during the check. No result was applied; check again after reconnecting.
The requested bot profile was not found. No other profile was searched; delivery remains unknown.
The history API returned 404 without confirming that the session is absent. Delivery remains unknown.
The server returned a different session ID. Its history was not applied; delivery remains unknown.
The available history pages do not contain this request. Older history may remain; delivery is unknown.
